newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korea firms say seeking 85,000T of U.S. soybeans.
newsitem.headline: S.Korea firms say seeking 85,000T of U.S. soybeans.

text.p: South Korea's major edible oil producers will buy a total of 85,000 tonnes of U.S. No.2 soybeans by early next week for shipment in March, officials of the companies said on Friday.
South Korea has three major edible oil producers -- Cheiljedang Corp, Shindongbang Corp, and Sam Yang Foods Co Ltd.
Officials said Sam Yang would buy 15,000 tonnes for shipment between March 1-20.
Cheiljedang and Shindongbang would also each purchase 35,000 tonnes for shipment in March.
Traders said the three companies are expected to buy the soybeans at basis over March futures on the Chicago Board of Trade through private negotiations.
The companies' shipments are scheduled from the U.S. Gulf to the South Korean port city of Inchon.
The three firms have previously bought 100,000 tonnes of U.S. No.2 soybeans for shipment in February -- Shindongbang taking 50,000 tonnes, Cheiljedang 35,000 tonnes and Sam Yang 15,000 tonnes.
